interpretation.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue

preconditions.name: A_OFF::salient_harm_events_fire
preconditions.description: harm_signal < 0 is the SOLE trigger for MECH-091's clock.phase_reset(), which de-periodises the E3 tick. It is also this run's only live release, so the interruption confound is unmeasurable without it.
preconditions.control: Fraction of formation-phase env steps with harm_signal < 0 on the num_hazards=2 grid; 810a measured 0.0267 against this 0.01 floor.

preconditions.name: A_OFF::pre_deval_delivered_benefit_supra_floor
preconditions.description: Gate (c), positive half. Benefit DELIVERED per resource contact BEFORE devaluation, an env-side quantity no policy can move. Without it there is nothing to devalue.
preconditions.control: Mean positive harm_signal per pre-devaluation resource contact, against env resource_benefit = 0.3.

preconditions.name: A_OFF::post_deval_delivered_benefit_at_zero
preconditions.description: Gate (c), negative half. Benefit delivered per resource contact AFTER devaluation must be zero. Policy-independent, so a null DV cannot be a devaluation failure in disguise.
preconditions.control: Mean positive harm_signal per post-devaluation resource contact after resource_benefit is driven to 0.0. An upper-bound CEILING: measured << threshold means the check PASSED.

preconditions.name: A_OFF::post_deval_steps_supra_floor
preconditions.description: Gate (d). The persistence rate's own DENOMINATOR. The 811 precedent: distinguish 'no data' from 'zero rate'.
preconditions.control: Count of post-devaluation steps per cell; 30 probe episodes x 36 post-devaluation steps = 1080 nominal against this 200 floor, so a shortfall means episodes were terminating early.

preconditions.name: A_OFF::pre_deval_approach_rate_supra_floor
preconditions.description: Gate (d). The persistence rate's own NUMERATOR baseline: a policy that never approached the resource cannot persist in doing so, and its ~0 persistence would be an artefact of having nothing to persist in.
preconditions.control: The SAME _approach_rate statistic the DV routes on, measured on the PRE-devaluation half of each probe episode -- a positive control by construction, since the outcome is still valuable there. Not a magnitude proxy (the V3-EXQ-643 rule).

preconditions.name: A_HIER_S2::episode_outcome_spread_supra_floor
preconditions.description: MECH-323's evaluative gate is RELATIVE to a running baseline, so a flat outcome stream makes formation structurally impossible whatever the substrate is doing. Asserts the SAME statistic the gate routes on (spread), not a magnitude proxy.
preconditions.control: Per-episode outcome pstdev over the 120-episode formation phase, the same schedule on which V3-EXQ-810a measured 0.349.

preconditions.name: A_HIER_S2::symbols_per_trial_supports_size_range
preconditions.description: note_outcome breaks out at len(actions) < size, so a buffer shorter than chunk_max_size makes the top of the size budget structurally unreachable -- V3-EXQ-810's actual failure.
preconditions.control: Recorded symbols per trial (chunk_acc_n_steps / n_outcomes) on the 72-step schedule, where 810a measured 9.41 against this 4.0 floor. At 810's 24-step schedule it was 3.00 and sizes 4-5 were structurally unreachable.
